title: Chapter 293 100,000 Undead Army Besieges The City
content:
Chapter 293 100,000 Undead Army Besieges The City

After setting up camp, Wang Shuo immediately contacted Lin Xiaodong.

"Lin County Magistrate, I wonder what the situation is with the undead besieging Changping County?"

After a while, Lin Xiaodong replied to Wang Shuo.

"There is a junior general, four top generals, and dozens of senior generals besieging Changping County. As for the skeleton soldiers, the number should be more than 100,000."

Wang Shuo was speechless for a long time after seeing this news.

There are only two senior generals in Wana Town.

And the last time he killed a junior general, he was completely unexpected, so he killed the opponent.

This time, the enemy lineup he faced was so strong that Wang Shuo was a little suffocated.

"How is it? Are you scared?"

Seeing that Wang Shuo did not reply for a long time, Lin Xiaodong replied again.

"No, I'm now stationed thirty or forty miles outside Changping County, trying to see if I can find any opportunities."

"Don't worry, the undead are accumulating strength, and we will have reinforcements. You just need to wait patiently, and I will notify you to take unified actions when the time comes."

"Okay."

Wang Shuo was also unsure in his heart, after all, there were too many enemies.

Let's see the situation first!

Divide the Wind Chasing Knights into 10-man teams and send them out to get information.

Wang Shuo opened the [Chat Channel] in the tent.

There were only 150,000 people left in the chat channel of Hedong County, nearly half of them disappeared.

"Everyone, this life is unbearable. We have been besieged for three days. Is there any great lord who can show mercy and come to rescue us!"

"Upstairs, don't think about it. How many people have this strength now!"

"It's better to rely on yourself than on heaven and earth."

Wang Shuo agreed with this sentence very much. If he hadn't actively thought of ways, he would have died in battles again and again!

At this moment, Wang Shuo noticed an important piece of information.

A player said that Su Xiu had led his troops to support Changping County.

This gave Wang Shuo a competitive feeling.

This Su Xiu and himself were always on par. Now that he was here, it seemed that he could meet him this time.

After a while, Goode walked in.

"Lord, according to the information just obtained. There are 8 large altars around Changping County, and a large number of undead skeletons are stationed near each altar."

"At the same time, 4 forces have been found nearby that are like us wandering on the edge of the skeleton army."

Wang Shuo was shocked. It seemed that there were quite a few people who thought the same as him.

"Can you see their flags clearly? Which forces are they?"

"Reply to Lord, the soldiers don't recognize their flags."

It seems that this time, not only do we have to eliminate these skeletons, but we also have to be wary of these allies.

Wang Shuo thought about it and decided to see if his Nanshan Club had any potential to tap.

In the past few days, the altars in the Nanshan Association's territory have basically been wiped out by Wang Shuo.

Only a few small groups of undead are left, which are left to other lords, at least to let others have some sense of participation!

"Brothers, have your territories been stabilized at present?"

"The leader has spoken, the leader has spoken..."

Now there are only 15 lords left in the Nanshan Association, and 3 of them defended the attack of the Burning Legion with their own strength.

The remaining 12, thanks to Wang Shuo's timely rescue, otherwise they might not have survived until now.

Therefore, the Nanshan Association's trust in Wang Shuo is already very high.

Even the three lords with good strength are grateful to Wang Shuo.

Mainly because they bought a large number of dead spirit beads before, and also followed Wang Shuo's advice to strengthen the city wall.

If they were not able to purchase a large number of resources from Wana Town and enter Wana Town's dungeon for training.

They probably wouldn't have achieved the current results.
